card.name: Words just before an expected object noun
card.fires_on: A verb, preposition or possessive in general web prose that sits right before a noun such as support, consent, trust or donation. The marked word is not itself the noun.

modes.label: Verb awaiting object
modes.description: A verb of giving, naming or recommending whose object comes next.
modes.example: An FDA panel<< recommended>> Truvada for preventive use

modes.label: Possessive or preposition
modes.description: A small word like their, in or have that leads into an abstract noun such as consent, hope or trust.
modes.example: if people withdraw<< their>> consent, both power and legitimacy

card.writes: It slightly favors word-start pieces such as 'ential', 'aign' and 'ogan', which suggests it helps build words like credential or campaign.
card.plain: It fires on a word that leads into an abstract noun, like trust, consent or support, which is about to come next.
